name: Basic salary
authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.94(1), 97(1): a monthly wage may be paid once a month or half-monthly; a half-monthly part pays half the month (terms.base_salary ÷ period.parts), prorated by the paid days of the part.

name: Overtime
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, (!work.holidays.exists(h, h.date == d.date && h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates)))) && !(d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]))).map(d, d.overtime_hours))
rate: 1.5 * ((terms.base_salary / double(period.parts)) / ((period.working_days > 0 ? double(period.working_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days) / double(period.parts)) * (size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0)) > 0 ? sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0).map(d, d.scheduled_hours)) / double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 0.0))) : double(rules.working_time.normal_hours_per_day))))
eligibility: sum(work.days.filter(d, (!work.holidays.exists(h, h.date == d.date && h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates)))) && !(d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]))).map(d, d.overtime_hours)) > 0.0
authority: Labour Code art.98(1)(a): at least 150% on a normal day. Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.54(1)(a3)–(a4): the day wage is the monthly wage divided by the normal working days of the month the enterprise chose, the hour wage the day wage divided by the normal hours of the day (Labour Code art.105); art.55(1)(a): the overtime hour wage is the month’s wage for the work divided by the actual normal hours of the month. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf. Engine: working days are period.working_days (WORK days of the planned shifts), hours a day the mean scheduled hours of those days; an entity without planned shifts falls back to rules.working_time (26 days of 8 hours, the most a 48-hour week allows under art.105).

name: Leave encashment

name: Stoppage pay reduction
rate: max(0.0, ((terms.base_salary / double(period.parts)) / (period.working_days > 0 ? double(period.working_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days) / double(period.parts))) - max(((terms.base_salary / double(period.parts)) / (period.working_days > 0 ? double(period.working_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days) / double(period.parts))) * (has(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) ? double(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) : 100.0) / 100.0, double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region in ["II", "III", "IV"] ? company.region : "I"]) / (period.working_days > 0 ? double(period.working_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days) / double(period.parts))))

eligibility: sum(work.days.filter(d, (!work.holidays.exists(h, h.date == d.date && h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates)))) && d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"])).map(d, (d.worked_hours > 0.0 ? d.worked_hours : d.overtime_hours))) > 0.0

authority: Labour Code art.98(1)(b): at least 200% on a weekly rest day; every hour worked on it is overtime (the recorded intervals, else the approved overtime). Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.54(1)(a3)–(a4): the day wage is the monthly wage divided by the normal working days of the month the enterprise chose, the hour wage the day wage divided by the normal hours of the day (Labour Code art.105); art.55(1)(a): the overtime hour wage is the month’s wage for the work divided by the actual normal hours of the month. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf.
